'''Coril Daskmin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who was a famous [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]. During the celebrations surrounding the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'', a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck that was once owned by Daskmin was on sale from [[Nenmo's Curios]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
